title: The batch runner fans out agents in parallel to sort, lint and combine lanes, and combined PRs grow as large as conflicts allow
why: The owner feels batching is too small and serial; the batch runner should scale by using more sub-agents and merging more lanes together.
source: Owner ruling 20:39 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant (triage did not see it).
note: Triage 20:40 CST Nov 13: plan owed. The coordinator and runner 10 send a plan by 21:00 CST Nov 13. Shape from the ruling: parallel agents sort, lint and combine lanes; combined PRs grow as large as conflicts allow; merges stay serial. Not yet checked by triage: how many lanes runner 10 combines today (unmeasured), and which existing steps overlap (combined-pr-recipe, drain-batch-measure). Runner 10 20:43 CST Nov 13 (its word; unchecked by triage): plan sent to the coordinator at 20:43. Starts now: Explore agents sort the done-keep rows. Two points need a ruling. (b) Who may push "merge main in" to lane PR branches beyond the clean-merge overlap grant, and who posts lane lint comments. (c) Combined PRs built by Sonnet builder agents, each with a named tracking session and a branch slug. The merge lock stays serial. Merges are held until the coordinator says go. Owner grant 20:43 CST (relayed by the consultant; ruling own-runner-workflow-optin): runner 10 may use Sonnet workflows inside its session, until withdrawn. Merge lock stays serial. Coordinator 20:48 CST Nov 13 (ruled 20:44, its own word, not the owner's): (b) the owning lane posts its own lint comment and merges main into its own PR; (c) Sonnet combine builders yes, tracker the coordinator, slugs combine-ci-speed and combine-held-a. Triage read: (b) widens no grant, since a lane merges main into its own PR; (c) keeps Sonnet as the ceiling. No owner item. Runner 10 20:50 CST Nov 13 (its word; unchecked): sort step (a) ran. Three read-only Sonnet agents checked 121 done-keep PRs by git merge-tree against main 309fa5ed5b28: 71 clean, 50 conflict. All are drafts with no CI run, so none can merge yet. Per-PR table is in its 20:49 message to the coordinator, not filed here.
